review_evidence: README identifies Lean theorem-prover cryptography experiments implementing SHA-3/SHAKE and explicitly notes use of dependent types and proofs, including formal bounds on array accesses.

Cryptography/Hashes/SHA3/Basic.lean defines dependent capacity/rate indices, sponge/hash-function states and KECCAK operations, with theorems such as RateIndexLTBlockMinCap and FixedBufferSize used to justify bounded accesses.
Cryptography/Hashes/SHA3/Lemmas.lean contains additional state-index bound theorems; the source is native formalized cryptographic implementation and proof material rather than wrapper tooling.
summary: Retain Cryptography as native Lean SHA-3/SHAKE implementation with dependent specifications and proof-backed bounds.
